title: MDTE: Minority-Aware Diffusion over Temporal Edge Events for Imbalanced Node Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.24812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Class-imbalanced node classification on temporal graphs is challenging because majority-dominated temporal propagation progressively assimilates minority representations, while conventional node and neighborhood information provides insufficient discriminative evidence for minority classes. To address these issues, we propose MDTE, a minority-aware diffusion framework that reconstructs stable and discriminative temporal edge-event representations through conditional diffusion denoising. Specifically, MDTE introduces Distribution-Aware Selective Propagation, which combines Local Outlier Factor (LOF)-based propagation filtering with cluster-aware low-frequency propagation. The module preserves informative neighborhood dependencies while mitigating harmful propagation and majority-class information assimilation. translated_title: MDTE：针对时间边缘事件的少数类感知扩散，用于不平衡节点分类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24812v1 公告类型：新 摘要：时间图上的类不平衡节点分类具有挑战性，因为多数类主导的时间传播会逐步同化少数类表示，而传统的节点和邻域信息为少数类提供的判别证据不足。为解决这些问题，我们提出了MDTE，一种少数类感知扩散框架，通过条件扩散去噪重建稳定且具有判别性的时间边缘事件表示。具体而言，MDTE引入了分布感知选择性传播，该模块结合了基于局部离群因子（LOF）的传播过滤和聚类感知的低频传播。该模块在保留信息丰富的邻域依赖性的同时，减轻了有害传播和多数类信息同化。它还进一步开发了多视图判别融合，利用特征重建和拓扑预测来刻画...
tldr: MDTE通过结合分布感知选择性传播和多视图判别融合的扩散框架，有效缓解了时间图中多数类传播对少数类表示的同化，从而提升了不平衡节点分类的判别能力。
en_tdlr: MDTE mitigates majority-class assimilation of minority representations in temporal graphs via a diffusion framework integrating distribution-aware selective propagation and multi-view discriminative fusion, enhancing imbalanced node classification.
